en.headline: Henderson Land marks 50 years with first pavilion at Wine and Dine Festival
en.dek: The developer will open a 2,000-square-foot space designed by Zaha Hadid Architects at the Central Harbourfront from 29 October, featuring limited dishes from 12 group restaurants.
body: Henderson Land Development will take part in the Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival for the first time as part of its 50th anniversary, setting up a pavilion at the Central Harbourfront Event Space from 29 October to 1 November.

The roughly 2,000-square-foot space, designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, draws on the curved lines of the group’s Central landmark The Henderson. It will bring together 12 restaurants and bars from the group’s portfolio, each offering limited-edition anniversary dishes or drinks.

Among the offerings is an egg waffle made with 50-year-aged dried tangerine peel and pu’er tea from the restaurant Tong Sut. Peridot, the bar at the top of The Henderson that was named among the world’s most beautiful restaurants, will serve three cocktails including the alcohol-free Henderson Green.
The Hong Kong Tourism Board organises the four-day festival under the theme “Taste the World’s Best”. Henderson Land said the pavilion is part of its broader anniversary programme.

zh.headline: 恒基地產50周年首設展館參與美酒佳餚巡禮
zh.dek: 發展商將於10月29日起在中環海濱設立約2000平方呎空間，由Zaha Hadid Architects設計，集合旗下12間餐廳限定菜式。
body: 恒基地產為慶祝成立50周年，首次參與香港美酒佳餚巡禮，將於10月29日至11月1日在中環海濱活動空間設立展館。
展館面積約2000平方呎，由Zaha Hadid Architects設計，靈感來自集團中環地標The Henderson的流線外形。場內集合旗下12間餐廳及酒吧，各推出周年限定菜式或飲品。
唐述將提供以50年陳皮及普洱茶製作的雞蛋仔。位於The Henderson頂層的Peridot酒吧，曾入選世界最美麗餐廳之一，將帶來包括無酒精Henderson Green在內的三款雞尾酒。
香港旅遊發展局主辦為期四日的巡禮，主題為「Taste the World’s Best」。恒基地產表示，展館是周年活動的一部分。
